name: ARMv8 / AArch64 Memory Model
description: A strengthened, formally specified model for ARMv8. Multi-copy atomic (stores become visible to all threads simultaneously). Introduces the LDAR/STLR acquire-release instructions. Strictly stronger than ARMv7.

mca.note: Pulte et al. give ARMv8 an explicitly multicopy-atomic semantics — the revised architecture (and this paper's title) fixes each write to become visible to all other threads at a single point.

catSupport.note: herd7's aarch64.cat is Arm's own machine-readable model — the architecture is officially specified in cat.

katSupport.note: kater's kat/arm8.kat: dob/aob/bob ordering and acyclic(ob), with ISB and DMB.ST introduced as extra fence predicates.
